Backend: POST /api/validacoes/validar-completa requires holerite_atual file (422 without)
Backend: POST /api/validacoes/validar-completa validates cliente_id exists (404 for invalid)

Backend: GET /api/validacoes/{id} returns full validation details

Backend: Análise Isolada - OCR extracts proventos/descontos/líquido
Backend: Comparação Mensal - Detects salary changes between months
Backend: Comparação Mensal - Returns divergências for significant changes
Backend: List validations by competência works correctly
Backend: View validation details returns all fields

Frontend: Login and navigation to /validacao works

Frontend: Dropzone for Holerite Mês Anterior (optional) present
Frontend: Dropzone for Arquivos de Apoio (optional, múltiplos) present

critical_code_review_comments: OCR extraction working correctly with Tesseract for text files
Brazilian monetary format (1.234,56) and American format (1234.56) both handled correctly
Temporary file flush() bug was fixed - files are properly written before OCR processing
seed_data_creation: Test holerite files available at /tmp/holerite_teste.txt and /tmp/holerite_anterior.txt
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validação de Folha feature is fully working with OCR local (Tesseract). The refactoring from AI-based to OCR-based extraction is complete. Key features tested: 1) Análise Isolada - upload only current holerite, extracts employee name, competência, proventos, descontos, líquido. 2) Comparação Mensal - upload current + previous month, detects divergências in salary changes. 3) OCR correctly parses Brazilian monetary format. 4) Frontend modal has all required elements. 5) Validations list shows grouped by competência with type badges.

validacao_folha_ocr.description: Payroll validation using local OCR (Tesseract) instead of AI APIs
endpoints: POST /api/validacoes/validar-completa - Unified validation with OCR extraction
GET /api/validacoes - List validations (with optional cliente_id filter)

ocr_extraction.proventos: WORKING - Extracts individual items and total
ocr_extraction.descontos: WORKING - Extracts INSS, IRRF, VT, etc.
ocr_extraction.liquido: WORKING - Calculates or extracts net pay

comparison_features.monthly_comparison: WORKING - Detects salary changes between months

ui_components: Dropzone for Arquivos de Apoio (optional, multiple)

rca_of_previous_issue.issue: Validação de Folha was completely broken
rca_of_previous_issue.root_cause: Previous code tried to use AI (LlmChat) but had undefined 'system_parts' variable
rca_of_previous_issue.fix_applied: Complete refactoring to use local OCR (Tesseract) instead of AI APIs
additional_fixes: Fixed flush() bug in temporary files - content was not being written to disk before OCR processing
Fixed monetary value parser to handle both Brazilian (1.234,56) and American (1234.56) formats
rca_of_previous_issue.verification: All 17 backend tests pass, frontend UI fully functional
